title: DeAr
desc: Marital bliss is disrupted for a newlywed pair when the husband, a sensitive sleeper, discovers his wife's snoring problem.

title: Milaka
desc: Azhagar, a young businessman, falls in love with Madurai. However, her three brothers constantly keep a watch on her activities.

title: Kaala
desc: Haridev Abhayankar, a corrupt minister, wishes to seize Dharavi's lucrative land for his own gain. However, Karikaalan, the locality's godfather, fights to protect his people's rights and assets.

desc: With Isha by his side, DJ Shiva rises to a crescendo of love and fortitude to embrace his role as the chosen protector of the universe's most powerful weapon.

title: Veera Simha Reddy
desc: Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.
